_about: Ireland. Same shape as data/regions/us/hearings/sources.json. Bodies are planning authorities; `state` is the ISO 3166-2 county code (IE-D) and `counties` the planning-authority names (GeocodeResult.county). Irish decisions are matched by distance across all bodies (Ground.decisions_scope = radius), not by authority. Decisions cite An Coimisiún Pleanála case pages (HTML); `decided_by` names the body that decided when it is not the parent body (An Coimisiún Pleanála on appeal), and the prompt says it. Decision lat/lon must be the application site: the Google row uses OSM relation 4546404 (Profile Park), named in the case's site description. No meeting is indexed yet.

decisions.text: On 2026-09-23 An Coimisiún Pleanála decided appeal PL06S.320852 (South Dublin ref. SD24A/0164W), Google Ireland Limited's ten-year application to expand its operations with a data storage facility at Grange Castle Business Park South and Profile Park, with the decision Grant Permissions with Conditions.
decisions.history: News reports say South Dublin County Council refused permission in August 2024 and Google appealed (lodged 18/09/2024); news reports a possible judicial review after the 2026 grant. Neither is on the cited page.
